classifiedFinding.title: stake(amount, recipient) lets anyone forcibly re-anchor a victim's reward-debt clock

classification.assetImpact: Forced-claim grief: attacker can trigger _claimRewards on a victim (forced taxable event, forced mint/transfer), and can selectively DoS via DEDUP-012 path (USDC blacklist, phUSD mint failure).
attackPath: 1. Victim has user.amount > 0 and pending rewards.
3. _claimRewards(victim) fires — claims pending rewards on attacker's schedule.
4. Selective DoS variant: if victim is USDC-blacklisted or phUSD mint reverts, the stake reverts, but the attack vector is enumerated by victim address.
classification.likelihood: medium — requires attacker willingness to spend MINIMUM_STAKE per grief

classifiedFinding.justification: Profile §4.3 labels this 'minor/benign'. Forced-claim is a real but low-impact griefing pattern; victim's rewards still go to victim, just earlier than intended. The selective-DoS variant is a re-statement of DEDUP-012 path. Demote to QA per the borderline note in the dedup detail.
classifiedFinding.notes: Sanitizer hinted potential-low. Classifier agrees: QA. Recommend require(recipient == msg.sender) or per-recipient approval.
